basic_details.job_title: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in an ISRO-sponsored project under the RESPOND Programme. The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms) for a project of two years. Applications go by email to [email protected] or through a Google Form, and the last date is 25 November 2026 (tentative). The interview is tentatively on 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing the documents listed below.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject "Application for JRF Position – ISRO RESPOND Project".
Alternatively, fill and upload the completed application form and all supporting documents through the Google Form: https://forms.gle/18NDdn1m6TyAcRUUA
The application form is placed at the end of the advertisement.
Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets.
List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any).
Any other supporting documents relevant to the project.
For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.
important_instructions: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for the interview. IIIT Pune reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on academic performance and relevant experience. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised position if suitable candidates are not found. The selected candidate shall not claim any regular appointment in IIIT Pune by virtue of this fellowship. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original documents have to be produced for verification at the time of interview/joining. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be considered. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The decision of IIIT Pune regarding selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
High Data Rate Channel Codec Architecture for Free Space Classical RF and Optical Communication
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), under the RESPOND Programme
Project duration two (02) years; initial appointment of six months
₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms)
Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
Email in a single PDF file, or the Google Form

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian nationals may apply. The essential qualification is a Postgraduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through a process described in either of these: (a) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship), or GATE. (b) Selection through National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE (formerly MHRD), ICAR, ICMR, IITs, IISc, IISER, etc. Preference will be given to candidates having one or more of the following desirable qualifications: Strong background in Digital Communication, Wireless Communication, Information Theory, Channel Coding and Error Control Coding. Knowledge of Optical Communication and Free Space Optical (FSO) Communication. Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar simulation/programming tools. Knowledge of communication system design and performance analysis. Good programming, analytical and technical writing skills. Research publications in relevant areas will be an added advantage. The notice does not mention a minimum experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms). The JRF will be appointed for an initial period of six months. Based on satisfactory performance, the appointment will be extended for the remaining duration of the project (up to two years), subject to the availability of project funds and institute/ISRO guidelines. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct research related to high-speed channel coding for classical RF and Free Space Optical communication systems. Design, simulate and evaluate communication algorithms. Develop software models and validate system performance. Assist in preparation of project reports, technical documents and research publications. Participate in meetings and other project-related activities assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Duly filled Application Form. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets. GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card. Experience certificates (if any). List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any). Any other supporting documents relevant to the project. Undertaking (Annexure I). For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened on eligibility and suitability for the project. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for the interview, and they are informed by email about the schedule. The interview may be conducted offline at IIIT Pune or online, depending on administrative requirements. Final selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials, research aptitude, technical competence and interview performance.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there at IIIT Pune?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Junior Research Fellow post in the ISRO-sponsored project under the RESPOND Programme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Pune JRF post?
faq.answer: The tentative last date for submission of application is 25-11-2026. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIIT Pune JRF post?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a national level examination of Central Government departments and their agencies/institutions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the fellowship for the IIIT Pune JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms).

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms), so HRA is shown in addition to the fellowship amount.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIIT Pune JRF post?
faq.answer: Send a single PDF with all documents by email to [email protected], or fill and upload the application through the Google Form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The subject should be "Application for JRF Position – ISRO RESPOND Project".

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the IIIT Pune JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications are screened, shortlisted candidates are interviewed offline at IIIT Pune or online, and final selection rests on academic credentials, research aptitude, technical competence and interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIIT Pune JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It starts with six months and may be extended up to two years, depending on performance and funds.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
